properties.description: Publish the gold SLA star to Azure SQL, gated on a row-count match. Runs the Databricks serve job (JDBC write of fct_sla + dims, dims first for the FKs), then Looks up the landed fct_sla count in SQL and compares it to the count the job reported writing. A mismatch means a short-write — the copy-integrity failure finance must never compute on — so the pipeline fails and nothing downstream reads the mart. This is the COPY-integrity gate; the M6 control total adds the SEMANTIC delivered-count gate.

activities.name: ServeToSql
activities.description: Runs serving/azure_sql/load_mart via a thin notebook wrapper that returns the fct_sla row count it wrote, through dbutils.notebook.exit, so ADF can compare it to what actually landed.

activities.name: LookupSqlCount
activities.description: Count the rows that actually landed in dbo.fct_sla.

source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM dbo.fct_sla

activities.name: GateOnRowCountMatch
activities.description: The pre-publish gate: the count the job wrote must equal the count that landed. If not, fail. Expression compares the notebook's returned fct_rows to the SQL COUNT(*).
